milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate toward and visually observe the smooth quartz stairs. The target is the exterior smooth quartz stair at spawn-relative (5, 0, 1), which was confirmed findable by the sandbox agent in steps 14-19. max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually approached the stairs rather than just standing at spawn (~5.1 blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the stairs, modeling 'the player can see the target.'
